meta.author:
火把音樂
詞／曲：胡斯漢、劉思捷

lines.a: 從無到有 看一切為美好

lines.b: One lie led to the fall

lines.a: 從有到無 將一切都毀壞
lines.b: And life was stolen by a shameless thief
Till You came and set me free

lines.a: 十字架 祢犧牲的救贖
lines.b: On the Cross You gave Your life for me

lines.a: 復活主 我重新得盼望
lines.b: Empty tomb - my hope is now renewed

lines.a: 懇求主 使用我 奪回這世代
lines.b: In Your name we reclaim this generation

lines.a: 黑暗的變光明 凋零的要盛開
lines.b: Darkness is turned to light, the withered is brought to life

lines.a: 我用信心看見 祢國降臨
lines.b: As we shout and declare Your victory

lines.a: 軟弱的得剛強 綑綁的得自由
lines.b: The powerless now made strong, the prisoners now set free
The hopeless ones now dance and sing

lines.a: 祢同在 帶領我 奪回這世代
lines.b: In Your name we reclaim this generation
